title: WR SOLO NEX Speedrun
summary: Gnomonkey completes a solo Nex speedrun in 26:30, which the description calls the fastest time by over 10 minutes. The video is mostly raw gameplay with little spoken explanation; the description credits Saxerpillar's lab work for making solo Nex possible and says the kill took 106 sweets.

outline.text: Run starts with a one-hour clock joke
Restoring stats at the altar before fighting Fumus; minions use most of the supplies
Frustration at repeated low damage rolls
Remainder of the run (little narration in the transcript)

claims.text: Gnomonkey's world record solo Nex speedrun finished with a final time of 26:30, which the video description says is the fastest time by over 10 minutes.
The video description says solo Nex became possible thanks to over a year of lab work by Saxerpillar.
According to the description, the final hurdles to solo Nex were max distance resets, blood sacrifice and ice prison tick eats, plus simply figuring out to tank through Glacies.
In Gnomonkey's solo Nex run, most of the supplies used over the whole kill go on defeating minions, because he cannot tick-eat while also killing them.
Gnomonkey says solo Nex is absolutely not worth it for GP, although it is still somewhat profitable.
Gnomonkey says solo Nex can be done 100% consistently and plans to speedrun it in the future.
Gnomonkey rates solo Nex as roughly equal in difficulty to a normal solo Theatre of Blood.
The 26:30 solo Nex run took 106 sweets, with many more used on attempts, and dragon arrows were also used up on the failed attempts.
Gnomonkey restores his stats at an altar before fighting Nex in the speedrun.
Gnomonkey set a 26:30 solo Nex time in January 2024, which the description calls the fastest time by over 10 minutes.
Gnomonkey thanked Condor in the description for helping him between planks during the solo Nex attempts.
Gnomonkey plans to speedrun solo Nex in the future.
